dedupe_keys.name: service des donnees et etudes statistiques sdes gas datasets

description: Service des données et études statistiques (SDES): gas datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Service des données et études statistiques (SDES). Coverage: Service des données et études statistiques (SDES). The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about gas; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Données locales de consommation d'électricité, de gaz naturel et de ch; Données locales de consommation d'électricité et de gaz naturel - régi; Données locales de consommation d'électricité et de gaz naturel - EPCI. Formats seen: HTML, PDF, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
